allow: PowerShell($ports = 3000,3001,3002; foreach \($p in $ports\) { try { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1; $proc = Get-Process -Id $conns.OwningProcess; Write-Output \("port ${p}: PID $\($proc.Id\) started $\($proc.StartTime\)"\) } catch { Write-Output \("port ${p}: not listening"\) } })
